name: relay
description: /relay and a handoff tool: update stale docs, save a handoff note to a temp file, compact, and continue from a prompt written before the compaction.

deliver.title: Deliver the continuation prompt
deliver.description: For a run you start with /relay. fill: put the prompt in the box for you to review and send (@ mentions expand). submit: send it at once (a plugin's prompt doesn't expand @ mentions, so the model is told to read the files). A handoff the agent starts by itself is always sent.

compactInstructions.title: Compaction instructions
compactInstructions.description: What the compaction summary should keep, as typed after /compact. relay adds that the handoff note is on disk, so the summary can stay short where the note covers something.
compactInstructions.default: Keep any information that's helpful to the agent and not written to a durable location.

instructionsFile.title: Compaction instructions file
instructionsFile.description: A file whose text is used in place of the compaction instructions above, read at each compaction. A leading ~ is your home directory. Empty, missing or unreadable: the instructions above.

noteDir.title: Handoff note directory
noteDir.description: Where the plugin writes each handoff note. Empty: the system temp directory's claude-relay/ ($TMPDIR, else /tmp), which the OS may clear on reboot.

saveInstructions.title: Save instructions
saveInstructions.description: Replaces the save turn's first step (update stale docs and notes in place), for example "Follow the <name> skill." A skill named here must be one the model can invoke. The handoff tool call stays, since relay needs it. Empty: the default step.

copyToClipboard.title: Copy the continuation prompt
copyToClipboard.description: Also copy the continuation prompt to the clipboard as a backup (runs you start with /relay only).

fillDuringCompaction.title: Fill the prompt box while compacting
fillDuringCompaction.description: With deliver fill: put the continuation prompt in the box as compaction starts, so you can press Enter to queue it before a background task finishes. Off: fill it once compaction has finished.

minTokens.title: Minimum context for the agent's own handoff (tokens)
minTokens.description: A handoff the agent starts by itself is declined below this context size, where a compaction costs more than it saves. /relay hands off at any size.
